self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Flower-Feather Song: +9.6% ATK per party member who is from Natlan or has a different Elemental Type from the wielder (max 3, i.e. all other party members); with 3+ such members also gain 48 Elemental Mastery. Select the number of qualifying party members.

en.flavor: A jade-adorned longbow. The gentle winds always seem to swirl gently about its string. Legends claim that this weapon was made in a far more ancient era by a dragon artisan.

refinements.1: For every party member from Natlan or who has a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the equipping character gains <r>4.8%</r> increased ATK. When there are no less than 3 of the aforementioned characters, the equipping character gains <r>24</r> Elemental Mastery.
refinements.2: For every party member from Natlan or who has a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the equipping character gains <r>6%</r> increased ATK. When there are no less than 3 of the aforementioned characters, the equipping character gains <r>30</r> Elemental Mastery.
refinements.3: For every party member from Natlan or who has a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the equipping character gains <r>7.2%</r> increased ATK. When there are no less than 3 of the aforementioned characters, the equipping character gains <r>36</r> Elemental Mastery.
refinements.4: For every party member from Natlan or who has a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the equipping character gains <r>8.4%</r> increased ATK. When there are no less than 3 of the aforementioned characters, the equipping character gains <r>42</r> Elemental Mastery.
refinements.5: For every party member from Natlan or who has a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the equipping character gains <r>9.6%</r> increased ATK. When there are no less than 3 of the aforementioned characters, the equipping character gains <r>48</r> Elemental Mastery.

fr.flavor: Un arc long orné de jade. Les vents doux semblent toujours tourbillonner doucement autour de sa corde. Les légendes prétendent que cette arme a été fabriquée à une époque bien plus ancienne par un artisan dragon.

refinements.1: Chaque personnage dans l'équipe de Natlan ou ayant un type élémentaire différent de celui du personnage équipé de l'arme augmente l'ATQ de ce dernier de <r>4,8 %</r>. Lorsque le nombre de ces personnages est supérieur ou égal à 3, la maîtrise élémentaire du personnage équipé de l'arme augmente de <r>24</r> pts.
